ITEM.PTXT: By touching "Settings" on the screen while the information mode screen is displayed, the screen changes to the settings screen, where continuous display settings for each operation screen, such as the audio operation screen and information screen, can be made. Also, the switch color of the settings screens (screens other than the map) can be selected from 2 types (green and orange).
In addition to the above settings, when a Bluetooth-compatible cellular phone is connected, settings for using the communication functions (G-BOOK ALPHA, hands-free and HELPNET) can also be made.
The personal information delete switch can delete information such as navigation memory point information, the hands-free phonebook and music recorded in the sound library.
